verdict.rationale: Galileo is an LLM observability and tracing platform, so masking or redacting sensitive data before traces are stored is an applicable axis. The evidence pack documents trace capture, OpenTelemetry stitching and the @log decorator, but nothing about PII masking, redaction hooks or data scrubbing before storage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces
